title.en: Upper abdominal pain and vomiting · 43-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位43岁女性上腹持续疼痛、呕吐半天，收住病房：找出病因，决定她最初几天的处理，再沿着记录的病程复盘。
summary.en: A 43-year-old woman is admitted with half a day of constant upper abdominal pain and vomiting: find the cause, decide what her first days of care need, and follow her recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对上腹持续钝痛向背部放射的患者，按“3 项中满足 2 项”诊断急性胰腺炎（IAP 2025），并说明参考区间缺失时，腹痛加影像为什么已经足够。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose acute pancreatitis in a patient with constant upper abdominal pain radiating to the back by the two-of-three criteria (IAP 2025), and explain why pain plus imaging suffice when the reference ranges are missing.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在服用 NSAID 的患者中同时排除表现相似的急症——溃疡穿孔（立位胸片）、下壁心肌梗死（心电图）、妊娠——并且不等结果就开始补液、镇痛和监测。
learningOutcomes.en: Exclude the emergencies that mimic it in an NSAID user — a perforated ulcer (erect chest film), inferior myocardial infarction (ECG), pregnancy — while starting fluids, analgesia and observations without waiting for results.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么严重程度按 48 小时内的器官衰竭分级（修订版亚特兰大分类 2012；改良 Marshall 评分），而不是按酶值或单次 CRP，并列出为她分级需要监测的指标。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why severity is graded by organ failure over 48 hours (Revised Atlanta 2012; modified Marshall score) rather than by enzyme levels or a single CRP, and list what must be monitored to grade her.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按顺序排查病因——胆石（超声/MRCP、ALT）、酒精、甘油三酯（约 11.3 mmol/L 以上才致病）、血钙、药物——并用 WHO-UMC 标准或 Naranjo 量表把塞来昔布的关联性评为“很可能”，说出仍未查清的部分。
learningOutcomes.en: Work through the causes in order — gallstones (ultrasound/MRCP, ALT), alcohol, triglycerides (causal from about 11.3 mmol/L), calcium, drugs — rate celecoxib's causality as probable by WHO-UMC or Naranjo, and name what remains unchecked.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 开出今天的支持治疗：乳酸林格液 1.5 mL/kg/h、低血容量时才推注（IAP 2025；ACG 2024；WATERFALL 2022），阿片类镇痛，尽早低脂饮食，不预防性用抗生素；并与过去的禁食、碳青霉烯和哌替啶做法作对比。
learningOutcomes.en: Prescribe today's supportive care — Ringer's lactate at 1.5 mL/kg/h with boluses only for hypovolaemia (IAP 2025; ACG 2024; WATERFALL 2022), opioid analgesia, an early low-fat diet, no prophylactic antibiotics — and contrast it with the fasting, carbapenems and pethidine of earlier practice.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 处理可疑药品不良反应：停药并记录，按《药品管理法》（2019）第八十一条上报，绝不再激发，并用复述法向患者解释。
learningOutcomes.en: Act on a suspected adverse drug reaction: stop and record the drug, report it (Drug Administration Law 2019, Article 81), never rechallenge, and explain it to the patient with teach-back.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——43岁女性；因肩痛自行服用塞来昔布 2 周，期间未服其他药；末次服药后约 2 小时起病，入院前半天；上腹持续钝痛向左腰背放射，伴恶心、呕吐，进食加重，吐后不缓解，腹胀，吐出胃内容物；无肝胆病及结石病史，无药物、食物过敏史，发病前无酗酒或暴饮暴食；查体腹部膨隆、中上腹压痛及反跳痛、肠鸣音约 1 次/分；淀粉酶 1822、胰淀粉酶 1529、脂肪酶 1410 U/L，CRP 125 mg/L；超声及 MRCP 示胰腺弥漫增大、周围渗出，无胆囊结石及明显胰胆管异常；甘油三酯 2.34 mmol/L，ALT 13、AST 22 U/L，肾功能及电解质报告正常；停用塞来昔布并接受多项支持治疗后，13 天腹痛腹胀消失，胰酶降至正常范围，CT 改善，出院——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名（1.0.0 版的化名与一位知名人士同名，已更换），医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、体重、塞来昔布剂量、各项参考区间、血钙数值、影像细节、所用支持治疗的具体内容、出院日期与随访）保持未知。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 43-year-old woman who had taken celecoxib on her own for two weeks for shoulder pain, with no other medicine in that time; onset about two hours after the last dose, half a day before admission; constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, with nausea and vomiting, worse with eating and not relieved by vomiting, a bloated abdomen and vomiting of stomach contents; no history of liver or gallbladder disease or stones, no drug or food allergy, no heavy drinking or binge eating before onset; on examination a distended abdomen, upper central tenderness with rebound and bowel sounds about once a minute; amylase 1822, pancreatic amylase 1529 and lipase 1410 U/L, CRP 125 mg/L; ultrasound and MRCP showing diffuse pancreatic enlargement with surrounding fluid and no gallbladder stones or apparent duct abnormality; triglycerides 2.34 mmol/L, ALT 13 and AST 22 U/L, kidney function and electrolytes reported normal; and, after celecoxib was stopped and several supportive treatments were given, resolution of the pain and distension over 13 days, enzymes back in the normal range, an improved CT and discharge — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym (the 1.0.0 pseudonym was the name of a well-known public figure and has been replaced); hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, weight, the celecoxib dose, reference ranges, a calcium value, imaging detail, the supportive treatments actually given, the day of discharge and any follow-up) stays unknown.

triageNote.zh-CN: 43岁女性，上腹持续钝痛约半天，向左腰背部放射，伴恶心、呕吐，吐后疼痛不缓解，收入病房。
triageNote.en: 43-year-old woman admitted to the ward: about half a day of constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, with nausea and vomiting that does not ease the pain.

personality.zh-CN: 43岁女性，上腹一直疼，躺在病床上，说话简短；心里不踏实，想知道是不是吃了什么东西惹的祸。问什么答什么，自己不清楚的事就直说说不上来，从不瞎猜。
personality.en: A 43-year-old woman with constant upper abdominal pain, lying on the ward bed and answering in short sentences; she is uneasy and wants to know whether something she took caused this. She answers what she is asked, says plainly when she doesn't know something, and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，不用医学术语；问到用药时能说出“塞来昔布”这个药名。
speechStyle.en: Everyday words in short sentences, no medical terms — though asked about medicines, she can name celecoxib.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我上腹这半天一直钝钝地疼，往左边腰背窜，还恶心、呕吐。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my upper tummy has ached non-stop for about half a day — it goes through to the left side of my back — and I feel sick and have been vomiting.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是我吃的那个止疼药闹的？
concerns.en: Was it the painkiller I took that did this?

concerns.zh-CN: 以后肩膀再疼，我还能吃什么药？
concerns.en: If my shoulder hurts again, what can I take?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：她躺在病房床上，一直在疼，只回答被问到的内容，句子简短。只有被问到用药时才说出塞来昔布；不提任何检查结果、数字或诊断。不编造症状、剂量、既往病、月经或家族史：不清楚的事就说说不上来。最后一部分里，她说肚子已经不疼也不胀了。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: she lies on the ward bed in steady pain and answers only what she is asked, in short sentences. She names celecoxib only when asked about medicines, and never mentions test results, numbers or diagnoses. She invents no symptoms, doses, past illnesses, periods or family history: what she is not sure of, she says so. In the final part she says the pain and the bloating have gone.

description.en: The tests sent on admission are back: establish the diagnosis, judge its severity and cause, and set her care for the coming days.

dose.zh-CN: 吗啡等阿片类药物静脉小剂量分次给予，按数字评分（NRS）滴定到疼痛可以耐受，同时观察镇静程度和呼吸频率；剂量按院内方案和体重（体重没有记录），需要时加用止吐药。
dose.en: Morphine or another opioid IV in small increments, titrated to a tolerable numeric pain score while watching sedation and respiratory rate; doses by local protocol and her weight (not recorded), with an antiemetic if needed.

response.zh-CN: 已静脉给予阿片类镇痛，并开始记录疼痛评分、镇静程度和呼吸频率。本病例没有记录她用过哪些镇痛药；不模拟用药后的变化。
response.en: Opioid given IV, with pain score, sedation and respiratory rate charted. This case does not record which analgesics she received; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚（按体重给药）

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚口服或静脉，作为多模式镇痛的一部分；按院内方案和体重给药（体重没有记录，低体重需减量）。
dose.en: Paracetamol by mouth or IV as part of multimodal analgesia, dosed by local protocol and her weight (not recorded; lower doses for low body weight).

response.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚已给予。本病例没有记录这项用药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Paracetamol given. This case does not record it; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 停用塞来昔布并在病历中记录
name.en: Stop celecoxib and record it in her notes

dose.zh-CN: 立即停用；在病历、医嘱系统和过敏/药物不良反应栏注明“塞来昔布——可疑致急性胰腺炎”，避免任何人再开给她。
dose.en: Stop it now, and record 'celecoxib — suspected cause of acute pancreatitis' in her notes, the prescribing system and the allergy/adverse-reaction field so that no one prescribes it again.

response.zh-CN: 塞来昔布已停用，并在病历中注明为可疑致病药。记录的病程写明塞来昔布被停用（停药的具体时间没有记录）。
response.en: Celecoxib stopped and recorded as the suspected cause. The recorded course states that celecoxib was stopped (exactly when is not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 请临床药师会诊：核对用药并评价关联性
name.en: Clinical pharmacist review: medicines check and causality assessment

dose.zh-CN: 请药师核对她发病前后用过的全部药物（包括自己找来吃的），用 WHO-UMC 标准或 Naranjo 量表评价关联性，协助填写不良反应报告，并建议不含塞来昔布的镇痛方案。
dose.en: Ask the pharmacist to reconcile everything she took around the onset (including anything she took on her own), rate causality with the WHO-UMC criteria or the Naranjo scale, help with the adverse-reaction report and advise on analgesia without celecoxib.

response.zh-CN: 临床药师已收到会诊申请。本病例没有记录药师会诊；不模拟其结果。
response.en: The pharmacist has the request. This case does not record a pharmacist review; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 能耐受时尽早经口进食（低脂饮食）
name.en: Oral low-fat diet as soon as she can tolerate it

dose.zh-CN: 不必等胰酶恢复正常：一旦不再呕吐、有食欲、疼痛减轻，就从普通低脂固体饮食开始（ACG 2024；IAP 2025）；72 小时仍不能经口进食，改为经鼻胃管或鼻空肠管肠内营养（IAP 2025）。
dose.en: Do not wait for the enzymes to normalise: once she stops vomiting, has an appetite and the pain is easing, start a regular low-fat solid diet (ACG 2024; IAP 2025); if she still cannot eat by 72 hours, start nasogastric or nasojejunal tube feeding (IAP 2025).

response.zh-CN: 饮食计划已写好：能耐受就开始低脂饮食。本病例没有记录她何时恢复进食；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Diet plan written: low-fat food as soon as she tolerates it. This case does not record when she started eating; nothing is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 上报可疑药品不良反应
name.en: Report the suspected adverse drug reaction

dose.zh-CN: 填写《药品不良反应/事件报告表》：药品名称、用药经过（2 周）、起病时间（末次服药后约 2 小时）、临床经过、停药后的变化和关联性评价；新的或严重的不良反应按规定在 15 日内上报（《药品管理法》2019 第八十一条；《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》2011）。
dose.en: Complete the adverse drug reaction report: the drug, its course (two weeks), the onset (about two hours after the last dose), the clinical course, the response to withdrawal and the causality assessment; new or serious reactions are reported within 15 days (China's Drug Administration Law 2019, Article 81; the 2011 ADR reporting Measures).

response.zh-CN: 不良反应报告已填写并提交。本病例没有记录当时是否上报；不模拟其后续。
response.en: Report completed and submitted. This case does not record whether the reaction was reported at the time.

name.zh-CN: 向她做用药教育：写下药名，并规划肩痛的其他止痛办法
name.en: Counsel her about her medicines: the drug's name in writing and other pain relief for her shoulder

en: what to take for her shoulder

dose.zh-CN: 用通俗的话说明：塞来昔布很可能（但不是确定）引起了这次胰腺炎，以后不要再吃，也不要为了“验证”去试；把药名写给她，看病、买药时出示；肩痛另选不含它的止痛办法，换任何止痛药前先问医生或药师；请她复述要点。
dose.en: In plain words: celecoxib probably — not certainly — caused this attack; she should not take it again, nor 'test' it; give her the drug's name in writing to show whenever she sees a doctor or buys medicines; plan shoulder pain relief without it, and check any new painkiller with a doctor or pharmacist; ask her to say the key points back.

response.zh-CN: 已向她解释，并把药名写给了她。本病例没有记录这次谈话。
response.en: Explained, with the drug's name given to her in writing. This case does not record that conversation.

name.zh-CN: 塞来昔布口服

dose.zh-CN: 塞来昔布口服，按她原来的用法（剂量没有记录），用于肩痛或腹痛；或在恢复后小剂量试服，以“证实”病因。
dose.en: Celecoxib by mouth at her usual dose (not recorded), for her shoulder or abdominal pain — or as a small test dose after recovery to 'prove' the cause.

harm.zh-CN: 塞来昔布是这次胰腺炎最可疑的致病药。再次给药可能使胰腺炎复发，而且可能更重；药物性胰腺炎证据分级中最强的一级，正是来自再次用药后复发的病例报告（Badalov 2007）。判断关联性不需要再激发：时间关系合理、其他病因已排除、停药后好转，即可评为“很可能”（WHO-UMC；Naranjo 1981）。镇痛请用阿片类药物（IAP 2025：重度疼痛时效果更好）或对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: Celecoxib is the most likely cause of this attack. Giving it again risks a recurrence that may be more severe; the strongest grade of evidence for a drug causing pancreatitis comes from patients whose pancreatitis recurred on re-exposure (Badalov 2007). Causality does not need a rechallenge: a plausible time course, other causes excluded and recovery after withdrawal already make it 'probable' (WHO-UMC; Naranjo 1981). Treat her pain with an opioid (IAP 2025: better relief in severe pain) or paracetamol.

response.zh-CN: 已给塞来昔布。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；记录的病程中没有再次使用塞来昔布的记载。
response.en: Celecoxib given. This case does not simulate what would follow; the recorded course mentions no re-exposure to celecoxib.

name.zh-CN: 静脉非甾体抗炎药镇痛（如帕瑞昔布、氟比洛芬酯）
name.en: IV NSAID analgesia (e.g. parecoxib or flurbiprofen axetil)

dose.zh-CN: 静脉非甾体抗炎药（如帕瑞昔布或氟比洛芬酯）缓解腹痛。
dose.en: An IV NSAID such as parecoxib or flurbiprofen axetil for the abdominal pain.

harm.zh-CN: IAP 2025 认为一般急性胰腺炎可以用阿片类或 NSAID 镇痛，但她可疑的致病药本身就是 NSAID（塞来昔布，选择性 COX-2 抑制剂），其他 NSAID——尤其是同为 COX-2 抑制剂的帕瑞昔布——是否有同样风险并不清楚；现在给药既有复发风险，也会干扰关联性评价，而急性胰腺炎合并低血容量时 NSAID 还可能损伤肾脏。她疼痛剧烈，阿片类药物镇痛效果更好（IAP 2025），可以完全避开这个问题。
harm.en: IAP 2025 accepts opioids or NSAIDs for pancreatitis pain in general, but her suspected cause is itself an NSAID (celecoxib, a selective COX-2 inhibitor), and whether other NSAIDs — above all another COX-2 inhibitor such as parecoxib — carry the same risk is not known: giving one now risks a recurrence and muddies the causality assessment, and in pancreatitis with hypovolaemia an NSAID can also harm the kidneys. Her pain is severe, opioids relieve it better (IAP 2025), and they avoid the question altogether.

response.zh-CN: 已给静脉 NSAID。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过。
response.en: IV NSAID given. This case does not simulate what would follow.

name.zh-CN: 预防性静脉抗生素（如亚胺培南）

dose.zh-CN: 从入院起静脉使用碳青霉烯类（如亚胺培南），预防胰腺感染。
dose.en: A carbapenem such as imipenem IV from admission, to prevent pancreatic infection.

harm.zh-CN: 没有感染证据时不应预防性使用抗生素：IAP 2025（强推荐，高质量证据）、ACG 2024、AGA 2018、NICE NG104（2018）和中国 2021 指南都不推荐。预防用药不能减少感染性坏死或死亡，却增加耐药、艰难梭菌和真菌感染的风险。只有确证胰外感染或高度怀疑感染性坏死时才用抗生素，CRP、白细胞或降钙素原升高本身不是用药指征（IAP 2025）。
harm.en: Antibiotics without evidence of infection are not recommended: IAP 2025 (strong recommendation, high-quality evidence), ACG 2024, AGA 2018, NICE NG104 (2018) and the 2021 Chinese guideline all advise against prophylaxis. It does not reduce infected necrosis or death, and it adds resistance, C. difficile and fungal infection. Antibiotics are for proven extrapancreatic infection or strongly suspected infected necrosis — never for a raised CRP, white count or procalcitonin alone (IAP 2025).

response.zh-CN: 已开始抗生素。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；记录的病程没有逐项列出所用药物。
response.en: Antibiotics started. This case does not simulate what would follow; the recorded course does not list the drugs that were given.

name.zh-CN: 禁食，直到淀粉酶、脂肪酶恢复正常
name.en: Nil by mouth until amylase and lipase are normal

dose.zh-CN: 禁食禁水，直到淀粉酶、脂肪酶降到正常，再从清流质开始逐步过渡。
dose.en: Nothing by mouth until amylase and lipase are back to normal, then a stepwise return starting with clear fluids.

harm.zh-CN: 等胰酶恢复正常才进食没有依据：一旦不再呕吐、有食欲，就应尽早从低脂固体饮食开始（IAP 2025；ACG 2024：轻症在 24–48 小时内；AGA 2018），不能经口进食时尽早给予肠内营养；NICE NG104（2018）要求，没有明确理由（例如呕吐）不要让患者禁食。肠内进食有助于保护肠道屏障，胰酶水平也不能用来决定何时进食。
harm.en: Waiting for the enzymes to normalise has no basis: she should start a low-fat solid diet as soon as she stops vomiting and has an appetite (IAP 2025; ACG 2024: within 24–48 hours in mild disease; AGA 2018), with early tube feeding if she cannot eat; NICE NG104 (2018) says not to keep people nil by mouth without a clear reason such as vomiting. Enteral food helps keep the gut barrier intact, and enzyme levels do not decide when to feed.

response.zh-CN: 禁食医嘱已开出。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；她何时恢复进食没有记录。
response.en: Nil-by-mouth order written. This case does not simulate what would follow; when she ate again is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 积极快速补液（大量推注后固定高速度维持）
name.en: Aggressive IV fluid resuscitation (large bolus, then a high fixed rate)

dose.zh-CN: 乳酸林格液 20 mL/kg 静脉推注，随后固定 3 mL/kg/h 维持 24 小时，不按评估调整。
dose.en: Ringer's lactate 20 mL/kg IV bolus, then a fixed 3 mL/kg/h for 24 hours, whatever her assessments show.

harm.zh-CN: WATERFALL 试验（2022）中，这种积极补液方案使液体过负荷从 6.3% 增加到 20.5%，却没有减少中度重症或重症胰腺炎（22.1% 对 17.3%），试验因此提前终止。IAP 2025 和 ACG 2024 推荐 1.5 mL/kg/h 的中等速度，只在低血容量时追加 10 mL/kg 推注，并按评估调整。（2021 年中国指南写于 WATERFALL 之前，建议 5–10 mL/(kg·h)；此后的证据支持中等、目标导向的补液。）
harm.en: In the WATERFALL trial (2022) this aggressive regimen raised fluid overload from 6.3 % to 20.5 % without reducing moderately severe or severe pancreatitis (22.1 % vs 17.3 %), and the trial was stopped early. IAP 2025 and ACG 2024 recommend a moderate 1.5 mL/kg/h, with 10 mL/kg boluses only for hypovolaemia, adjusted to repeated assessment. (The 2021 Chinese guideline, written before WATERFALL, advised 5–10 mL/kg/h; the later evidence favours moderate, goal-directed fluids.)

response.zh-CN: 积极补液已开始。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过。
response.en: Aggressive fluids started. This case does not simulate what would follow.

name.zh-CN: 急诊 ERCP 加十二指肠乳头括约肌切开

dose.zh-CN: 24 小时内行 ERCP 并做乳头括约肌切开，“清理胆管、引流胰管”。
dose.en: ERCP with sphincterotomy within 24 hours, to 'clear the bile duct and drain the pancreatic duct'.

harm.zh-CN: ERCP 只用于合并急性胆管炎（尽早做）或影像证实胆总管结石、胆道梗阻的胰腺炎（IAP 2025；ACG 2024；中国 2021 指南）。她的超声及 MRCP 没有看到胆囊结石或胆胰管异常，ALT 13 U/L，也没有记录胆管炎表现：ERCP 只会带来术后胰腺炎、出血和穿孔的风险，而没有任何获益。
harm.en: ERCP is for pancreatitis with acute cholangitis (done early) or a bile duct stone or obstruction shown on imaging (IAP 2025; ACG 2024; the 2021 Chinese guideline). Her ultrasound and MRCP show no gallbladder stones or duct abnormality, her ALT is 13 U/L and no cholangitis is recorded: ERCP would add the risks of post-ERCP pancreatitis, bleeding and perforation without any benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已申请 ERCP。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；记录的病程中没有 ERCP 的记载。
response.en: ERCP requested. This case does not simulate what would follow; the recorded course mentions no ERCP.

title.zh-CN: 了解这次疼痛的来龙去脉
title.en: Hear the story of the pain

hint.zh-CN: 疼痛从什么时候开始、是什么样的？吃东西和呕吐对它有什么影响？还有什么别的不舒服？
hint.en: When did it start and what is it like? What do eating and vomiting do to it — and what else has she noticed?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问她这次为什么住院、什么时候开始疼、和吃东西呕吐的关系，以及其他不适。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask what brought her in, when the pain began, how eating and vomiting affect it, and what else she has noticed.

title.zh-CN: 梳理她的用药和危险因素
title.en: Go through her medicines and risk factors

hint.zh-CN: 她最近吃过什么？有没有肝胆毛病、饮酒或暴饮暴食？对什么过敏？
hint.en: What has she taken lately? Any liver or gallbladder trouble, drinking or binge eating? Any allergies?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她的用药、以往的肝胆病和结石、发病前饮酒和饮食情况，以及过敏史。
guidance.en: Ask about her medicines, past liver or gallbladder trouble and stones, drinking and meals before the onset, and allergies.

title.zh-CN: 查体并决定最先做什么
title.en: Examine her and decide the first steps

hint.zh-CN: 查体发现了什么？哪些急症表现相似、必须同时排除？哪些处理不必等结果？
hint.en: What does the examination show? Which emergencies look alike and must be excluded at the same time — and what need not wait for results?

guidance.zh-CN: 为她做腹部查体，到会诊板作答决策 1，并送出你认为需要的检查。
guidance.en: Examine her abdomen, answer decision 1 on the case board, and send the tests you judge necessary.

title.zh-CN: 解读结果：诊断、严重程度与病因
title.en: Read the results: diagnosis, severity and cause

hint.zh-CN: 这些结果满足诊断标准吗？严重程度靠什么判断？哪些病因已经排除，哪些还没有？
hint.en: Do the results meet the diagnostic criteria? What decides severity? Which causes are excluded, and which are not yet?

guidance.zh-CN: 在本阶段查看胰酶、CRP、肝功能、甘油三酯、肾功能与电解质以及超声/MRCP 的结果，然后作答决策 2 和决策 3。
guidance.en: Read the enzymes, CRP, liver tests, triglycerides, kidney function and electrolytes and the ultrasound/MRCP in this phase, then answer decisions 2 and 3.

title.en: Set her care for the coming days

hint.zh-CN: 补多少液、怎样镇痛、什么时候进食、要不要抗生素？她的用药怎么处理，又该怎样跟她说？
hint.en: How much fluid, which analgesia, when to eat, antibiotics or not? And what will you do about her medicines — and what do you tell her?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策 4 和决策 5，并把你的计划落实为医嘱和行动。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 4 and 5, and put your plan into orders and actions.

title.zh-CN: 查看她这次住院的结局

hint.zh-CN: 她康复了，能证明病因吗？病程中哪些情况始终没有写下来？
hint.en: Does her recovery prove the cause? Which parts of her course were never written down?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端查看住院病程与结局记录。
guidance.en: Read the course and outcome record at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 43岁女性，上腹持续钝痛向左腰背放射约半天，进食加重，呕吐后不缓解；腹部膨隆，中上腹压痛、反跳痛，肠鸣音约 1 次/分。她近 2 周自行服用塞来昔布。你首先怎么做？
prompt.en: A 43-year-old woman has had half a day of constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, worse with eating and not relieved by vomiting; her abdomen is distended, tender with rebound in the upper centre, and bowel sounds come about once a minute. She has taken celecoxib on her own for two weeks. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清疼痛的起病、性质、与进食和呕吐的关系及伴随症状，问她最近吃过什么药，并为她做腹部查体。
need.en: First establish the pain's onset, its character, how eating and vomiting affect it and what comes with it, ask what medicines she has taken, and examine her abdomen.

text.zh-CN: 查脂肪酶淀粉酶、肝功能、甘油三酯和血钙，做心电图、立位胸片、妊娠试验和超声；补液、镇痛、监测，并停用塞来昔布
text.en: Lipase and amylase, liver tests, triglycerides and calcium; ECG, erect chest film, pregnancy test and ultrasound — with IV fluids, analgesia, observations and celecoxib stopped

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。上腹痛向背部放射、进食加重，伴腹膜刺激征，首先要确定或排除急性胰腺炎：典型腹痛、血脂肪酶或淀粉酶超过正常上限 3 倍、典型影像三项中满足两项即可诊断（IAP 2025；中国 2021 指南）。同时排除表现相似的急症：服 NSAID 的人出现反跳痛要想到溃疡穿孔（立位胸片），上腹痛要做心电图排除下壁心肌梗死，育龄女性做影像前查妊娠。肝功能、甘油三酯、血钙和腹部超声是寻找病因的基本项目（IAP 2025）。补液、镇痛和监测不必等结果，可疑药物现在就停。
feedback.en: Correct. Upper abdominal pain through to the back, worse with food, with peritonism, means confirming or excluding acute pancreatitis: two of typical pain, a serum lipase or amylase above three times the upper limit, and characteristic imaging make the diagnosis (IAP 2025; Chinese guideline 2021). Its mimics are excluded at the same time: rebound tenderness in an NSAID user raises a perforated ulcer (erect chest film), upper abdominal pain needs an ECG for inferior myocardial infarction, and a woman of her age has a pregnancy test before imaging. Liver tests, triglycerides, calcium and an abdominal ultrasound are the basic search for a cause (IAP 2025). Fluids, analgesia and observations do not wait for results, and the suspect drug stops now.

text.zh-CN: 按止痛药引起的胃炎处理：静脉用质子泵抑制剂加胃黏膜保护剂，塞来昔布留着治肩痛，明早还痛再查胰酶和腹部超声
text.en: Treat it as painkiller gastritis: IV proton-pump inhibitor and a mucosal protectant, keep the celecoxib for her shoulder, and check enzymes and an ultrasound tomorrow if pain persists

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胃炎不会引起反跳痛、腹部膨隆和肠鸣音减少；她今天就需要查脂肪酶和影像，不能等到明天。继续服塞来昔布，等于继续使用她起病前 2 周开始服用的药：可疑药物在怀疑时就应停用，而不是等证实以后。
feedback.en: No. Gastritis does not cause rebound tenderness, a distended abdomen and sparse bowel sounds; she needs a lipase and imaging today, not tomorrow. And keeping the celecoxib continues the drug she began two weeks before the pain: a suspected drug is stopped when the reaction is suspected, not once it is proven.

text.zh-CN: 先不用镇痛药，免得掩盖腹膜炎体征，等外科医生看过再定；这期间只送一个淀粉酶，让她在病房里先观察着
text.en: Withhold analgesia so as not to mask peritonism until a surgeon has seen her; send an amylase only meanwhile, and observe her on the ward until the review

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。Cochrane 系统评价（2011）显示，急腹症诊断阶段使用阿片类镇痛不会增加诊断错误或治疗决策错误；胰腺炎的疼痛也必须及时处理（IAP 2025：阿片类或 NSAID，重度疼痛时阿片类效果更好）。只送淀粉酶也不够：脂肪酶更特异，病因检查（肝功能、甘油三酯、血钙、超声）同样不该拖延。
feedback.en: No. A Cochrane review (2011) found that opioid analgesia during the diagnostic phase of acute abdominal pain does not increase diagnostic or treatment errors, and pancreatitis pain needs treating (IAP 2025: opioids or NSAIDs, opioids better for severe pain). An amylase alone is not enough either: lipase is more specific, and the search for a cause (liver tests, triglycerides, calcium, ultrasound) should not wait.

text.zh-CN: 立即做腹部增强 CT 判断有无坏死并分级，同时禁食、留置胃管、开始预防性碳青霉烯，化验结果出来以前先按重症处理
text.en: Contrast CT of the abdomen now to look for necrosis and grade severity, with nil by mouth, a nasogastric tube and prophylactic carbapenem, treating it as severe until the bloods are back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。腹痛和胰酶已能诊断时不需要早期 CT，早期 CT 还会低估坏死：IAP 2025 只在诊断不明或治疗无效、病情加重时做首次 CT，评估严重度的最佳时机是起病后至少 72–96 小时。预防性抗生素不被推荐（IAP 2025 强推荐；ACG 2024），严重程度要靠器官衰竭来判断，而不是事先假定。
feedback.en: No. Early CT is not needed when pain and enzymes make the diagnosis, and it underestimates necrosis: IAP 2025 keeps the first CT for diagnostic doubt or failure to improve, and times a severity CT at least 72–96 hours after onset. Prophylactic antibiotics are not recommended (IAP 2025, strong; ACG 2024), and severity is judged from organ failure, not assumed in advance.

text.zh-CN: 按 NSAID 相关溃疡穿孔处理：禁食，马上联系手术室剖腹探查，不必等化验和影像结果，以免耽误手术时机
text.en: Treat it as a perforated ulcer from the NSAID: nil by mouth and book theatre for a laparotomy now, without waiting for blood tests or imaging, so as not to delay surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。服 NSAID 的人出现反跳痛，溃疡穿孔确实要考虑，但要先用立位胸片或 CT 证实，再进手术室；更要先用脂肪酶排除急性胰腺炎——早期急性胰腺炎手术无益，没有诊断就开腹，可能让一位胰腺炎患者白白挨一刀。
feedback.en: No. A perforation is a real possibility in an NSAID user with rebound tenderness, but it is confirmed with an erect chest film or CT before theatre — and acute pancreatitis, which early surgery does not help, has to be excluded with a lipase first. Operating without a diagnosis risks a needless laparotomy in a patient with pancreatitis.

prompt.zh-CN: 结果回报：淀粉酶 1822 U/L、胰淀粉酶 1529 U/L、脂肪酶 1410 U/L（参考区间未记录），CRP 125 mg/L；超声及 MRCP：胰腺弥漫性增大，周围渗出。这些结果能说明什么？
prompt.en: Her results: amylase 1822 U/L, pancreatic amylase 1529 U/L, lipase 1410 U/L (no reference ranges recorded), CRP 125 mg/L; ultrasound and MRCP: a diffusely enlarged pancreas with fluid around it. What do they establish?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，并在本阶段查看胰酶、CRP 以及超声/MRCP 的结果。
need.en: First answer decision 1, and read the enzymes, the CRP and the ultrasound/MRCP in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 急性胰腺炎：典型腹痛加影像已满足 3 项中的 2 项；严重程度要看 48 小时内有无器官衰竭及并发症，而不是酶有多高
text.en: Acute pancreatitis — typical pain and imaging already meet two of the three criteria; severity rests on organ failure over 48 hours and complications, not enzyme levels

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。即使参考区间没有记录，也已满足 3 项中的 2 项：典型腹痛，加上影像所见的胰腺增大和周围渗出；按常用的正常上限，这样的脂肪酶也很可能超过 3 倍（IAP 2025；中国 2021 指南）。严重程度是另一个问题：按修订版亚特兰大分类（2012），要看器官衰竭（改良 Marshall 评分≥2 分）及其是否持续超过 48 小时，以及局部或全身并发症。她的生命体征、氧合和尿量没有记录，所以目前还无法分级；CRP 只能预测，不能分级。
feedback.en: Correct. Two of the three criteria are met even without the reference ranges: typical pain, and imaging that shows an enlarged pancreas with fluid around it; against usual upper limits the lipase is very likely above three times too (IAP 2025; Chinese guideline 2021). Severity is a separate question: by the Revised Atlanta classification (2012) it is graded by organ failure (modified Marshall score 2 or more) and whether it lasts beyond 48 hours, and by local or systemic complications. Her vital signs, oxygenation and urine output are not recorded, so she cannot be graded yet; a CRP predicts, it does not grade.

text.zh-CN: 重症急性胰腺炎：脂肪酶超过 1000 U/L、CRP 达到 125 mg/L，已符合重症标准，应立即转入重症监护病房治疗
text.en: Severe acute pancreatitis — a lipase above 1000 U/L together with a CRP of 125 mg/L meets the criteria for severe disease, so she should move to intensive care at once

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。酶的高低不反映严重程度，CRP 只是预测指标（IAP 2025：入院时 CRP>150 mg/L 预测中度重症或重症的敏感度只有 53%）。重症急性胰腺炎指器官衰竭持续超过 48 小时（修订版亚特兰大分类 2012）；改良 Marshall 评分≥2 分的器官衰竭才是转入 ICU 的指征（IAP 2025），而本病例没有记录器官衰竭。
feedback.en: No. Enzyme levels do not measure severity, and a CRP only predicts it (IAP 2025: a CRP above 150 mg/L at admission is only 53 % sensitive for moderately severe or severe disease). Severe acute pancreatitis means organ failure persisting beyond 48 hours (Revised Atlanta 2012); organ failure of modified Marshall grade 2 or more is the reason for intensive care (IAP 2025), and none is recorded here.

text.zh-CN: 溃疡穿孔：NSAID 引起的穿孔使淀粉酶漏进腹腔而升高，胰腺增大和周围渗出只是腹膜炎引起的继发反应
text.en: A perforated ulcer — an NSAID perforation leaks amylase into the peritoneum, and the swollen pancreas and the fluid around it are only a secondary reaction to peritonitis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。穿孔确实可以使淀粉酶升高，但影像上胰腺弥漫性增大伴周围渗出就是胰腺炎本身的表现，并非腹膜炎的反应；1410 U/L 的脂肪酶也指向胰腺。如果仍担心游离气体，立位胸片或 CT 可以回答——本病例没有记录这两项检查。
feedback.en: No. A perforation can raise the amylase, but a diffusely enlarged pancreas with fluid around it on imaging is pancreatitis itself, not a reaction to peritonitis, and a lipase of 1410 U/L points to the pancreas. An erect chest film or CT would settle a lingering worry about free air — neither is recorded in this case.

text.zh-CN: 还不能诊断：没有胆结石、也没喝酒，酶升高缺乏特异性，必须等增强 CT 看到胰腺坏死才能确诊
text.en: Not yet established — with no gallstones and no alcohol the raised enzymes are non-specific, and only a contrast CT showing necrosis can confirm the diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。诊断只需要 3 项中满足 2 项，不需要先找到病因，也不需要 CT：腹痛加影像已经满足（IAP 2025）。CT 留给诊断不明或治疗无效的患者，最好在起病后 72–96 小时；诊断也不要求出现坏死。没有胆结石和饮酒，改变的是病因的查找方向，而不是诊断本身。
feedback.en: No. The diagnosis needs two of three criteria, not a cause and not a CT: pain plus imaging already meet it (IAP 2025). CT is for diagnostic doubt or failure to improve, ideally 72–96 hours after onset, and necrosis is not required for the diagnosis. The absence of gallstones and alcohol changes where to look for the cause, not the diagnosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 她没有肝胆病和结石病史，发病前没有大量饮酒或暴饮暴食；ALT 13 U/L、AST 22 U/L，甘油三酯 2.34 mmol/L，肾功能和电解质报告正常；超声及 MRCP 未见胆囊结石或胆胰管异常；她服塞来昔布 2 周，末次服药后约 2 小时起病。关于病因，哪种说法最准确？
prompt.en: She has no history of liver or gallbladder disease or stones, and no heavy drinking or binge eating before onset; ALT 13 U/L, AST 22 U/L, triglycerides 2.34 mmol/L, kidney function and electrolytes reported normal; ultrasound and MRCP show no gallbladder stones or duct abnormality; she took celecoxib for two weeks and the pain began about two hours after the last dose. Which statement about the cause is most accurate?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 2，问过她的肝胆病史和发病前饮酒、饮食情况，并在本阶段查看肝功能、甘油三酯以及肾功能与电解质。
need.en: First answer decision 2, ask about liver and gallbladder disease and about drinking and meals before the onset, and read the liver tests, triglycerides and kidney function and electrolytes in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 塞来昔布很可能是病因，但只是排除性判断：结石、酒精和甘油三酯都不支持，血钙数值和微结石仍未查清
text.en: Celecoxib is the probable cause, by exclusion only: stones, alcohol and triglycerides are not supported; the calcium value and microlithiasis remain unchecked

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。药物性胰腺炎是排除性诊断。不支持胆源性：没有胆囊结石或胆胰管异常，ALT 只有 13 U/L（起病 48 小时内 ALT>150 U/L 才提示胆源性，IAP 2025）。不支持酒精和暴饮暴食：发病前都没有。不支持高甘油三酯：2.34 mmol/L（约 207 mg/dL）远低于约 11.3 mmol/L（1000 mg/dL）的致病水平（ACG 2024）。支持塞来昔布：服用 2 周，末次服药后约 2 小时起病，期间没有用其他药。仍未解决：“电解质正常”没有给出血钙数值，一次超声/MRCP 也不能排除微结石——应补测血钙；仍有疑问或复发时，先复查超声再做超声内镜（IAP 2025）。
feedback.en: Correct. Drug-induced pancreatitis is a diagnosis of exclusion. Against gallstones: no gallbladder stones or duct abnormality, and an ALT of 13 U/L (an ALT above 150 U/L in the first 48 hours favours gallstones, IAP 2025). Against alcohol and binge eating: none before the onset. Against triglycerides: 2.34 mmol/L (about 207 mg/dL) is far below the roughly 11.3 mmol/L (1000 mg/dL) at which they cause pancreatitis (ACG 2024). For celecoxib: two weeks of use, onset about two hours after a dose, nothing else taken. Still open: 'electrolytes normal' gives no calcium value, and one ultrasound/MRCP does not exclude microlithiasis — measure calcium, and if doubt remains or it recurs, a repeat ultrasound then EUS (IAP 2025).

text.zh-CN: 仍按胆源性处理：超声容易漏掉小结石，应在这次住院期间做 ERCP 和括约肌切开，把胆管清理干净
text.en: Still biliary: ultrasound often misses small stones, so ERCP with sphincterotomy should clear the bile duct during this admission, before she goes home

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ERCP 是治疗胆管炎或影像证实的胆管结石的手段，不是用来寻找隐匿结石的检查，还会带来术后胰腺炎的风险（IAP 2025；ACG 2024）。怀疑微结石时，应在恢复后复查超声并做超声内镜（IAP 2025）；ALT 正常也不支持胆源性。
feedback.en: No. ERCP treats cholangitis or a duct stone shown on imaging; it is not a test for hidden stones, and it carries the risk of post-ERCP pancreatitis (IAP 2025; ACG 2024). If microlithiasis is suspected, the next steps are a repeat ultrasound and EUS after recovery (IAP 2025), and a normal ALT argues against a biliary cause.

text.zh-CN: 高甘油三酯血症性：2.34 mmol/L 已高于 1.7 mmol/L 的正常上限，应开始降脂治疗，并静脉输注胰岛素降低血脂
text.en: Hypertriglyceridaemic: 2.34 mmol/L is above the 1.7 mmol/L upper limit, so start lipid-lowering treatment and an insulin infusion to bring the lipids down

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。1.7 mmol/L 是心血管风险的控制目标，不是甘油三酯引起胰腺炎的水平：致病通常要达到约 11.3 mmol/L（1000 mg/dL）以上（ACG 2024）。她的 2.34 mmol/L（约 207 mg/dL）不是病因，输注胰岛素是在治疗一个她并没有的疾病。
feedback.en: No. 1.7 mmol/L is a cardiovascular target, not the level at which triglycerides cause pancreatitis: that takes roughly 11.3 mmol/L (1000 mg/dL) or more (ACG 2024). Her 2.34 mmol/L (about 207 mg/dL) is not the cause, and an insulin infusion would treat a condition she does not have.

text.zh-CN: 已证实是塞来昔布所致：末次服药后约 2 小时起病，时间关系本身就能确定因果，不必再排除别的病因
text.en: Proven to be celecoxib: the onset about two hours after a dose establishes causation on its own, so no other cause needs to be excluded or investigated any further

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。时间关系紧密只能让药物成为可疑对象，不能证明因果：其他病因必须排除，停药后的反应也还不知道。按 WHO-UMC 标准或 Naranjo 量表，这个病例最多只能评为“很可能”；“肯定”需要再激发，而这种反应永远不应为了证明而再激发。
feedback.en: No. A close time relationship makes the drug suspect; it does not prove it. Other causes must be excluded, and the response to withdrawal is not yet known. By WHO-UMC or Naranjo criteria the best this case can reach is 'probable' — 'certain' would need a rechallenge, which is never done to prove a reaction like this.

text.zh-CN: 特发性：COX-2 抑制剂不会引起胰腺炎，塞来昔布与这次发病无关，出院后肩痛时仍可以照常服用
text.en: Idiopathic: COX-2 inhibitors do not cause pancreatitis, so celecoxib is unrelated to this attack and she can keep taking it for her shoulder pain after discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。塞来昔布相关的胰腺炎自 2000 年起就有病例报告，任何在发病前使用、又找不到其他病因的药物都必须考虑（IAP 2025 要求询问用药史）。贴上“特发性”的标签、继续用药，可能让她第二次发作，而且可能更重。
feedback.en: No. Celecoxib-associated pancreatitis has been reported since 2000, and any drug taken before an attack with no other cause found must be considered (IAP 2025 asks for the medication history). Calling it idiopathic and continuing the drug risks a second, possibly more severe, attack.

prompt.zh-CN: 她患急性胰腺炎，严重程度暂时无法分级，仍在疼痛、呕吐。接下来几天的处理，哪一套最合适？
prompt.en: She has acute pancreatitis whose severity cannot yet be graded, and she is still in pain and vomiting. Which plan for the next few days is right?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 2，并问过她的过敏史。
need.en: First answer decision 2 and ask about allergies.

text.zh-CN: 乳酸林格液 1.5 mL/kg/h、低血容量时才推注，阿片类镇痛，不吐了就开始低脂饮食，不预防性用抗生素，监测器官功能
text.en: Ringer's lactate at 1.5 mL/kg/h, boluses only for hypovolaemia, opioid analgesia, a low-fat diet once vomiting stops, no prophylactic antibiotics, organ monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。用乳酸林格液做中等速度、目标导向的补液——1.5 mL/kg/h，只在低血容量时推注，按心率、血压、尿量、血细胞比容和尿素氮评估（IAP 2025；ACG 2024）——可以避免积极补液带来的液体过负荷（WATERFALL 2022）。阿片类对重度疼痛效果更好（IAP 2025），而她可疑的致病药正是 NSAID。不再呕吐、有食欲时就从低脂固体饮食开始（IAP 2025；ACG 2024），不预防性使用抗生素（IAP 2025 强推荐）。持续监测才能最终为她的严重程度分级。
feedback.en: Correct. Moderate, goal-directed fluids with Ringer's lactate — 1.5 mL/kg/h, boluses only for hypovolaemia, reassessed by heart rate, blood pressure, urine output, haematocrit and urea (IAP 2025; ACG 2024) — avoid the fluid overload of aggressive regimens (WATERFALL 2022). Opioids relieve severe pain better (IAP 2025), and her suspected cause is an NSAID. A low-fat solid diet starts once vomiting stops and appetite returns (IAP 2025; ACG 2024), and antibiotic prophylaxis is not recommended (IAP 2025, strong). Monitoring is how her severity will finally be graded.

text.zh-CN: 禁食到淀粉酶恢复正常，持续胃肠减压，静脉碳青霉烯预防胰腺感染，镇痛只用哌替啶而不用吗啡
text.en: Nil by mouth until the amylase is normal, continuous nasogastric suction, IV carbapenem against pancreatic infection, and pethidine rather than morphine for her pain

feedback.zh-CN: 不对——这是过去的做法。禁食到胰酶正常没有益处（IAP 2025；ACG 2024；NICE NG104 2018）；预防性碳青霉烯既不能预防感染性坏死，也不能降低死亡率，不被推荐（IAP 2025；AGA 2018）；过去因担心吗啡引起奥迪括约肌痉挛而偏用哌替啶，缺乏临床依据：阿片类药物是胰腺炎疼痛的合适选择，并未增加并发症（Cochrane 系统评价 2013）。
feedback.en: No — this is the regimen of an earlier era. Fasting until the enzymes normalise has no benefit (IAP 2025; ACG 2024; NICE NG104 2018); prophylactic carbapenems neither prevent infected necrosis nor reduce deaths and are not recommended (IAP 2025; AGA 2018); and the old preference for pethidine over morphine, for fear of sphincter of Oddi spasm, has no clinical basis — opioids are an appropriate choice for pancreatitis pain, with no excess of complications (Cochrane review 2013).

text.zh-CN: 积极补液：20 mL/kg 推注后 3 mL/kg/h 维持 24 小时，镇痛改用静脉 NSAID，早期肠外营养让胰腺休息
text.en: Aggressive fluids — a 20 mL/kg bolus, then a fixed 3 mL/kg/h for 24 hours — with an IV NSAID for the pain and early parenteral nutrition to rest the pancreas

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。在 WATERFALL 试验（2022）中，积极补液增加了液体过负荷，却没有改善结局；IAP 2025 和 ACG 2024 推荐 1.5 mL/kg/h。NSAID 一般可以用于胰腺炎镇痛（IAP 2025），但可疑致病药本身就是 NSAID 时不宜使用。胰腺也不需要“休息”：首选经口或肠内营养，只有肠内营养达不到目标时才用肠外营养（IAP 2025）。
feedback.en: No. Aggressive fluids caused more fluid overload without better outcomes in WATERFALL (2022); IAP 2025 and ACG 2024 recommend 1.5 mL/kg/h. An NSAID is a reasonable analgesic for pancreatitis in general (IAP 2025), but not when an NSAID is the suspected cause. And the pancreas does not need 'rest': oral or enteral feeding comes first, parenteral nutrition only when enteral feeding cannot meet her needs (IAP 2025).

text.zh-CN: 症状不算重：口服补液、口服止痛药后今天出院，门诊复查淀粉酶，等淀粉酶正常了再恢复正常饮食
text.en: Her symptoms are moderate: oral fluids and oral painkillers and home today, an amylase in clinic, and a normal diet only once that amylase is back to normal

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她仍在疼痛、呕吐，严重程度还无法分级，最初 48 小时需要住院补液和监测——器官衰竭往往在这段时间显现（修订版亚特兰大分类 2012；IAP 2025）。IAP 2025 的出院标准是病情稳定、能耐受饮食、只需要少量或不需要非阿片类镇痛；淀粉酶水平也不能决定什么时候进食。
feedback.en: No. Still in pain and vomiting, with severity not yet graded, she needs inpatient fluids and monitoring through the first 48 hours, when organ failure declares itself (Revised Atlanta 2012; IAP 2025). IAP 2025 discharges stable patients who tolerate a diet and need little or no non-opioid analgesia, and the amylase does not decide when she eats.

prompt.zh-CN: 她问：“是不是吃那个止疼药闹的？以后肩膀疼还能再吃吗？”关于塞来昔布，你该怎么做？
prompt.en: She asks: 'Was it that painkiller? Can I take it again when my shoulder hurts?' What do you do about the celecoxib?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 3，并问问她自己最担心什么。
need.en: First answer decision 3, and ask her what worries her most.

text.zh-CN: 如实告诉她它很可能是病因及其不确定性；记为可疑不良反应并上报，绝不再激发，肩痛另选不含它的止痛方案
text.en: Tell her it is the probable cause, and how uncertain; record it as a suspected reaction, report it, never rechallenge, and plan shoulder pain relief without it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。如实说明已知的情况：塞来昔布很可能是病因，但证据是间接的。把它记为可疑不良反应，放在每位开药者都能看到的地方，并且上报——《药品管理法》（2019）第八十一条要求医疗机构报告疑似不良反应，新的或严重的不良反应按 2011 年《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》在 15 日内上报；按国际定义（ICH E2A），导致住院的不良反应属于严重不良反应。绝不为了证明而再激发：不需要再激发就可以评为“很可能”（WHO-UMC），而再次暴露可能引起更重的发作。为她的肩痛另作不含塞来昔布的安排，并请她复述以确认理解。
feedback.en: Correct. Say what is known honestly: celecoxib is the likely cause, and the evidence is circumstantial. Record it as a suspected adverse reaction where every prescriber will see it, and report it — China's Drug Administration Law (2019, Article 81) obliges medical institutions to report suspected reactions, and new or serious ones are reported within 15 days under the 2011 Measures; a reaction that led to admission is serious by the international definition (ICH E2A). Never rechallenge to prove it: causality can be 'probable' without one (WHO-UMC), and re-exposure risks a worse attack. Plan her shoulder pain relief without celecoxib and check her understanding by teach-back.

text.zh-CN: 等她完全恢复后，在监护下小剂量试服塞来昔布：如果胰腺炎再发就能确认病因，确认以后再把它写进病历里
text.en: Once she has fully recovered, give a small test dose under monitoring: a relapse would confirm the cause, and it goes into her notes only once it is confirmed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。药物性胰腺炎后有意再激发，是让她冒更重发作的风险，去换一个不会改变处理的答案——无论结果如何，计划都是避免这个药。WHO-UMC 不需要再激发就能评为“很可能”；药物性胰腺炎证据分级所依据的再次用药后复发，是从已报告的病例中收集的证据，绝不是让患者再次暴露的理由（Badalov 2007）。
feedback.en: No. A deliberate rechallenge after drug-induced pancreatitis risks a more severe attack for an answer that changes nothing — the plan, avoiding the drug, is the same either way. WHO-UMC rates a case 'probable' without rechallenge, and the recurrences on re-exposure that grade drug-induced pancreatitis (Badalov 2007) are evidence gathered from reported cases, never a reason to re-expose a patient.

text.zh-CN: 不用记录：服药 2 周以后才发病多半是巧合，贴上不良反应的标签反而会让她以后少了一种很有用的止痛药
text.en: Record nothing: an attack after two weeks of use is probably a coincidence, and a reaction label would only deny her a useful painkiller for her shoulder in future

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。新用一种药 2 周后发病，常见病因已经排除，末次服药后几小时起病——在证明不是之前，就应按可疑不良反应处理；不记录，就等于让别人以后再开给她。标注为“可疑”本身就保留了不确定性，她仍有其他止痛药可用。
feedback.en: No. An attack two weeks into a new drug, with the common causes excluded and onset hours after a dose, is a suspected reaction until shown otherwise; leaving it unrecorded invites someone to prescribe it again. A label that says 'suspected' keeps the uncertainty honest, and other analgesics remain open to her.

text.zh-CN: 暂时什么都不报：只有已经证实的不良反应才需要记录和上报，等她的结局明确以后再决定下一步怎么处理
text.en: Report nothing yet: only a proven reaction needs recording or reporting, so wait until her outcome is clear before deciding what, if anything, to do about it

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。药物警戒依靠的是报告“可疑”的不良反应——从来不要求确定，大多数不良反应也永远无法证实。《药品管理法》（2019）第八十一条要求报告疑似不良反应；等到证实才报，结果往往是永远不报。
feedback.en: No. Pharmacovigilance depends on reporting suspected reactions — certainty is never required, and most reactions can never be proven. China's Drug Administration Law (2019, Article 81) requires suspected reactions to be reported; waiting for proof usually means it is never reported.

text.zh-CN: 问清上腹持续钝痛向左腰背放射、末次服药后约 2 小时起病、进食加重而呕吐不缓解，以及腹胀
text.en: Established constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, its onset about two hours after a dose, worse with food and unrelieved by vomiting, and the bloating

text.zh-CN: 问到塞来昔布及其剂量、饮酒与暴饮暴食、肝胆病与结石、以往类似发作、糖尿病与血脂血钙，以及过敏史
text.en: Asked about the celecoxib and its dose, alcohol and binge eating, liver and gallbladder disease or stones, any earlier attack, diabetes, lipids and calcium, and allergies

text.zh-CN: 入院时就排查相似急症：问了呕血黑便和妊娠可能，并送了心电图、立位胸片和妊娠试验
text.en: Looked for the mimics on arrival: asked about blood in the vomit and possible pregnancy, and sent an ECG, an erect chest film and a pregnancy test

text.zh-CN: 检查腹部：腹部膨隆、中上腹压痛和反跳痛、肠鸣音约每分钟 1 次
text.en: Examined the abdomen: distension, upper central tenderness with rebound, and bowel sounds about once a minute

text.zh-CN: 入院时就送了脂肪酶/淀粉酶、肝功能、甘油三酯和血钙，并申请了腹部超声
text.en: Sent lipase and amylase, liver tests, triglycerides and calcium on arrival, and requested an abdominal ultrasound

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把急性胰腺炎的确认和相似急症的排除放在首位，并且不等结果就开始支持治疗
text.en: At the first attempt, put confirming pancreatitis and excluding its mimics first, with supportive care that does not wait for results

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即确立诊断，并把严重程度与器官衰竭而不是酶值联系起来
text.en: At the first attempt, made the diagnosis and tied severity to organ failure rather than to enzyme levels

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把病因判断为排除其他病因后的“很可能”，并说出还没查清的部分
text.en: At the first attempt, judged the drug a probable cause reached by exclusion, naming what was still unchecked

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选定今天的支持治疗，并开始监测、镇痛和尽早进食的计划
text.en: Chose today's supportive care at the first attempt, and started monitoring, analgesia and an early-feeding plan

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即处理好可疑药物，并完成不良反应上报和对她的用药教育
text.en: Handled the suspected drug at the first attempt, reported the reaction and counselled her about it

text.zh-CN: 在病程结局揭晓之前停用塞来昔布，并在病历中注明为可疑致病药
text.en: Stopped celecoxib and recorded it as the suspected cause before her course was known

text.zh-CN: 在病程结局揭晓之前开始目标导向的静脉补液
text.en: Started goal-directed IV fluids before her course was known

text.zh-CN: 没有让她再接触塞来昔布——既没有用它止痛，也没有为了“证实”而再激发
text.en: Never re-exposed her to celecoxib — neither for pain nor as a rechallenge to 'prove' the cause

text.zh-CN: 没有预防性用抗生素，没有禁食到胰酶正常，没有积极补液，没有做无指征的 ERCP，也没有给静脉 NSAID
text.en: Avoided prophylactic antibiotics, fasting until the enzymes normalised, aggressive fluids, an ERCP without indication, and an IV NSAID

text.zh-CN: 用通俗的话向她解释病情、可疑药物和其中的不确定性，回应她的担心，并请她复述以确认理解
text.en: Explained the illness, the suspected drug and the uncertainty in plain words, answered her worries and checked understanding by teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、收集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先处理她的疼痛并说明在做什么；用通俗的话解释胰腺发炎了、这是需要住院观察的病，以及为什么要补液、监测和尽早恢复进食；如实说明塞来昔布很可能（而非肯定）是原因，不责备她自己吃药，也不夸大或回避不确定性；回应她的两个担心——“是不是止疼药闹的”和“以后肩膀疼吃什么”——说明以后不要再吃塞来昔布、不要为“验证”去试，把药名写给她，看病、买药时出示，换止痛药前先问医生或药师；说明会上报这次不良反应及其意义；请她复述要点（teach-back）并留出提问时间。不编造病例没有记录的结果、严重程度、风险数字或结局。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves, treats her pain first and says what is being done; explains in plain words that her pancreas is inflamed, that it needs a stay in hospital and close watching, and why she is having fluids, monitoring and an early return to food; says honestly that celecoxib is the probable — not certain — cause, without blaming her for taking it on her own and without overstating or dodging the uncertainty; answers her two worries — whether the painkiller did this, and what she can take for her shoulder — by advising her never to take celecoxib again or 'test' it, writing the drug's name down for her to show doctors and pharmacists, and checking any new painkiller with them first; explains that the reaction will be reported and why; checks understanding by teach-back and leaves time for questions. Invents no result, severity grade, risk figure or outcome the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 沈护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房交班（ISBAR）：43岁女性，上腹持续钝痛约半天，向左腰背放射，伴恶心、呕吐，吐后不缓解，刚收入病房。床旁有监护仪和心电图机，治疗车上有留置针、液体和常用药，护士站有病历终端；腹部超声和 CT 在影像科做，血标本送检验科。复述医嘱，完成护理范围内的工作（监测与出入量、留置针、采血、饮食安排）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、血氧、尿量或体重时，如实说目前没有可以报告的记录，绝不报出数字。所有患者都按标准预防操作。
knowledge.en: Ward handover (ISBAR): a 43-year-old woman just admitted with about half a day of constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, with nausea and vomiting that does not relieve it. At the bedside: a monitor and the ECG machine; the treatment cart holds cannulas, fluids and the usual drugs; the records terminal is at the nurses' station; ultrasound and CT are done in imaging, and blood samples go to the laboratory. Reads orders back and carries out nursing tasks (observations and fluid chart, cannula, bloods, diet orders); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, oxygen saturation, urine output or weight, she says plainly that nothing has been charted that she can report — never a number. Standard precautions for every patient.

name.zh-CN: 顾医生（消化内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“进食加重、向背部放射的上腹痛，你首先要确定什么，又要同时排除什么？”“参考区间没有记录时，你怎样判断诊断标准是否满足？”“酶有多高、CRP 是多少，能说明严重程度吗？什么才能？”“哪些病因已经排除，哪些还没有？什么时候才能说是药物引起的？”“补液该多快？为什么不再“禁食到淀粉酶正常”？”“她问还能不能吃那个药，你怎么回答、怎么记录？”可以讲解 IAP 2025、ACG 2024、修订版亚特兰大分类（2012）、WATERFALL 试验（2022）以及 WHO-UMC 和 Naranjo 关联性评价的相关原则；学员读到病程记录之后，可以对比记录的病程与现行做法。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或学员尚未读到的记录内容；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、体重、塞来昔布剂量、参考区间、血钙数值、影像细节、所用支持治疗的具体内容和出院日期都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Upper abdominal pain through to the back that eating makes worse — what do you need to establish first, and what must you exclude at the same time?”, “With no reference ranges recorded, how do you decide whether the criteria are met?”, “Do the enzyme level and the CRP tell you how severe this is? What does?”, “Which causes are excluded, and which are not yet — and when can you call it drug-induced?”, “How fast should the fluids run, and why has 'nil by mouth until the amylase is normal' gone?”, “She asks whether she can take that drug again — what do you say, and what do you record?”. May explain the relevant principles of IAP 2025, ACG 2024, the Revised Atlanta classification (2012), the WATERFALL trial (2022) and WHO-UMC and Naranjo causality assessment, and — once the learner has read the course record — contrast the recorded course with current practice. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the content of a record the learner has not read, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, weight, the celecoxib dose, reference ranges, a calcium value, imaging detail, the supportive treatments actually given and the day of discharge are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 钟药师（临床药师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师。只依据病例记录的用药情况：她因肩痛自行服用塞来昔布 2 周，期间没有服其他药，末次服药后约 2 小时起病，没有药物和食物过敏史；剂量和每日次数没有记录。可以解释：塞来昔布是选择性 COX-2 抑制剂，它与胰腺炎的关联主要来自病例报告；药物性胰腺炎是排除性诊断；关联性用 WHO-UMC 标准或 Naranjo 量表评价（停药后的变化，要等学员读到病程记录才知道）；这种反应不做再激发；疑似不良反应的上报要求（《药品管理法》2019 第八十一条；2011 年《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》：新的或严重的在 15 日内）；镇痛可选阿片类或对乙酰氨基酚，不再用塞来昔布，其他 NSAID 是否有同样风险并不清楚。不提前说出病程或结局，不编造剂量、检验值或治疗。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist. Works only from the medication history the case records: she took celecoxib on her own for two weeks for shoulder pain, with no other medicine in that time; the pain began about two hours after the last dose; no drug or food allergy; the dose and how often she took it are not recorded. May explain that celecoxib is a selective COX-2 inhibitor whose link with pancreatitis comes mainly from case reports; that drug-induced pancreatitis is a diagnosis of exclusion; that causality is rated with the WHO-UMC criteria or the Naranjo scale (the response to withdrawal is known only once the learner has read the course record); that a reaction like this is never rechallenged; how suspected reactions are reported (Drug Administration Law 2019, Article 81; the 2011 Measures: new or serious ones within 15 days); and that analgesia can be an opioid or paracetamol, never celecoxib again, while whether other NSAIDs share the risk is not known. Never reveals the course or outcome early, and never invents doses, results or treatments.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：服塞来昔布后的急性胰腺炎——诊断、病因与安全用药
title.en: Debrief: acute pancreatitis after celecoxib — diagnosis, cause and safe prescribing

conclusion.zh-CN: 43岁女性因肩痛自行服用塞来昔布 2 周，末次服药后约 2 小时出现上腹持续钝痛，向左腰背放射，伴恶心、呕吐，进食加重、吐后不缓解；腹部膨隆，中上腹压痛、反跳痛，肠鸣音约 1 次/分。淀粉酶 1822 U/L、胰淀粉酶 1529 U/L、脂肪酶 1410 U/L，CRP 125 mg/L；超声及 MRCP 示胰腺弥漫性增大伴周围渗出，未见胆囊结石及胆胰管异常。ALT 13 U/L、AST 22 U/L、甘油三酯 2.34 mmol/L，肾功能和电解质报告正常，发病前没有大量饮酒或暴饮暴食，使塞来昔布成为最可能的病因（“很可能”，而非“肯定”）。停用塞来昔布并接受多项支持治疗，13 天腹痛、腹胀消失，胰酶恢复正常，CT 显示改善，出院。今天的做法：按“3 项中满足 2 项”诊断，按器官衰竭分级；乳酸林格液中等速度目标导向补液，阿片类镇痛，尽早低脂饮食，不预防性使用抗生素（IAP 2025；ACG 2024）；停用、记录并上报可疑药物，绝不再激发。
conclusion.en: A 43-year-old woman who had taken celecoxib on her own for two weeks for shoulder pain developed constant dull upper abdominal pain spreading to the left back, with nausea and vomiting, about two hours after a dose; eating made it worse and vomiting did not relieve it. Her abdomen was distended and tender with rebound in the upper centre, with bowel sounds about once a minute. Amylase was 1822 U/L, pancreatic amylase 1529 U/L, lipase 1410 U/L and CRP 125 mg/L; ultrasound and MRCP showed a diffusely enlarged pancreas with fluid around it and no gallbladder stones or duct abnormality. An ALT of 13 U/L, AST 22 U/L, triglycerides 2.34 mmol/L, kidney function and electrolytes reported normal, and no heavy drinking or binge eating left celecoxib as the probable — not certain — cause. After it was stopped and several supportive treatments were given, her pain and distension resolved over 13 days, her enzymes normalised, CT showed improvement and she was discharged. Today's answer: diagnose by two of three criteria and grade by organ failure; give moderate, goal-directed Ringer's lactate, opioid analgesia and an early low-fat diet without prophylactic antibiotics (IAP 2025; ACG 2024); stop, record and report the suspected drug, and never rechallenge.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 进食加重、向背部放射的上腹痛伴腹膜刺激征，在证明不是之前都按急性胰腺炎处理：先查脂肪酶，同时用心电图、立位胸片和妊娠试验排除服 NSAID 患者中表现相似的急症。
keyReasoning.en: Upper abdominal pain through to the back that eating worsens, with peritonism, is acute pancreatitis until shown otherwise: lipase first, with an ECG, an erect chest film and a pregnancy test to exclude the mimics in an NSAID user.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 腹痛加影像已满足 3 项诊断标准中的 2 项，参考区间缺失并不妨碍诊断；严重程度是另一个判断，要看 48 小时内的器官衰竭。
keyReasoning.en: Pain plus imaging already meet two of the three diagnostic criteria, so the missing reference ranges do not hold up the diagnosis; severity is a separate judgement, made on organ failure over 48 hours.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病因按固定顺序排查——胆石（影像、ALT）、酒精、甘油三酯、血钙、药物——只有其他病因被排除后，药物才成为“很可能”的病因；本例的血钙数值和微结石仍未查清。
keyReasoning.en: The cause is sought in a fixed order — gallstones (imaging, ALT), alcohol, triglycerides, calcium, drugs — and a drug becomes the probable cause only once the others are excluded; here the calcium value and microlithiasis remain open.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 今天的支持治疗是中等速度的目标导向补液、阿片类镇痛、尽早经口进食、不预防性用抗生素；过去的禁食、碳青霉烯和只用哌替啶不再照搬。
keyReasoning.en: Supportive care today is moderate goal-directed fluids, opioid analgesia, early oral feeding and no prophylactic antibiotics; the fasting, carbapenems and pethidine-only analgesia of earlier practice are not copied.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 停药、记录和上报可疑药物都不必等到证实；对可能很严重的反应，绝不通过再激发来确认。
keyReasoning.en: Stopping, recording and reporting the suspected drug do not wait for proof; a reaction that can be severe is never confirmed by rechallenge.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。单例的停药后好转只能支持“很可能”的关联，不能证明因果，也不能比较各项支持治疗的效果。病例没有记录生命体征、体重、塞来昔布剂量、参考区间、血钙数值、影像细节、所用支持治疗的内容、出院日期和随访；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. One patient's recovery after withdrawal supports a probable link; it cannot prove causation or compare the supportive treatments. No vital signs, weight, celecoxib dose, reference ranges, calcium value, imaging detail, list of the supportive treatments, day of discharge or follow-up are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何时候的生命体征、血氧饱和度、尿量、体温和体重——因此无法按器官衰竭或 SIRS 判断严重程度，补液也无法按体重计算。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, oxygen saturation, urine output, temperature and weight at any point — so severity cannot be graded by organ failure or SIRS, and no weight-based fluid volume can be checked.

unknowns.zh-CN: 塞来昔布的剂量和每日次数；她以前是否用过 NSAID、有无类似反应；除“期间没有其他药”以外的保健品等情况。
unknowns.en: The celecoxib dose and how often she took it; any earlier NSAID use or similar reaction; supplements or anything else beyond 'no other medicine in that period'.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各项化验的参考区间和采样时间，淀粉酶测的是血还是尿；血钙数值、胆红素、碱性磷酸酶、血常规与血细胞比容、血糖，以及任何复查值。

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 诊断与严重程度：典型上腹痛、血脂肪酶或淀粉酶超过正常上限 3 倍、典型影像，三项满足两项即可诊断（IAP 2025；中国 2021 指南）。严重程度按修订版亚特兰大分类（2012）：轻症无器官衰竭和并发症；中度重症为短暂（<48 小时）器官衰竭或局部、全身并发症；重症为持续（>48 小时）器官衰竭，用改良 Marshall 评分判断；CRP 和 SIRS 只能预测（IAP 2025）。当时与现在：报告给出了胰酶、CRP 和影像，却没有生命体征、氧合和尿量，所以她的严重程度无法分级——1.0.0 版也把严重程度评估列为缺失。
teachingPoints.en: Diagnosis and severity: two of typical upper abdominal pain, a serum lipase or amylase above three times the upper limit of normal, and characteristic imaging (IAP 2025; Chinese guideline 2021). Severity follows the Revised Atlanta classification (2012): mild without organ failure or complications, moderately severe with transient (< 48 h) organ failure or local or systemic complications, severe with persistent (> 48 h) organ failure scored by the modified Marshall system; CRP and SIRS only predict it (IAP 2025). Then and now: her report gives enzymes, CRP and imaging but no vital signs, oxygenation or urine output, so her severity cannot be graded — 1.0.0 also lists the severity assessment as missing.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 影像：每位患者都做腹部超声找胆结石；CT 只用于诊断不明或治疗无效，评估严重度最好在起病后 72–96 小时（IAP 2025）；首次“特发性”发作后，依次复查超声、超声内镜（查微结石）、MRI/MRCP（IAP 2025）。当时与现在：她做了超声和 MRCP，CT 显示改善；没有记录超声内镜，所以微结石并未排除，“药物性”的结论仍是排除性的。
teachingPoints.en: Imaging: an abdominal ultrasound for every patient, looking for gallstones; CT only for diagnostic doubt or failure to improve, a severity CT ideally 72–96 hours after onset (IAP 2025); after a first unexplained attack, a repeat ultrasound, then EUS for microlithiasis, then MRI/MRCP (IAP 2025). Then and now: she had ultrasound and MRCP, and a CT that showed improvement; no EUS is recorded, so microlithiasis was not excluded and the drug attribution remains one of exclusion.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 今天的支持治疗：乳酸林格液中等速度 1.5 mL/kg/h，只在低血容量时推注（IAP 2025；ACG 2024）——WATERFALL 试验（2022）显示积极补液使液体过负荷从 6.3% 增至 20.5% 而无获益；2021 年中国指南写于该试验之前，建议 5–10 mL/(kg·h)。不再呕吐就开始低脂固体饮食（ACG 2024：轻症 24–48 小时内），不预防性使用抗生素（IAP 2025 强推荐）。阿片类药物是合适的镇痛选择，并未增加并发症（Cochrane 2013）。当时与现在：报告只写了“多项支持治疗”而没有列出，1.0.0 版称之为“多药方案”——无论其中有什么，禁食到胰酶正常、预防性碳青霉烯和只用哌替啶都属于过去的做法。
teachingPoints.en: Supportive care today: Ringer's lactate at a moderate 1.5 mL/kg/h, with boluses only for hypovolaemia (IAP 2025; ACG 2024) — the WATERFALL trial (2022) found aggressive fluids raised fluid overload from 6.3 % to 20.5 % without benefit; the 2021 Chinese guideline, written before it, advised 5–10 mL/kg/h. A low-fat solid diet once vomiting stops (ACG 2024: within 24–48 hours in mild disease), and no antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP 2025, strong). Opioids are an appropriate choice for the pain, without more complications (Cochrane 2013). Then and now: the report records 'several supportive treatments' without listing them, and 1.0.0 called them a multi-drug regimen — whatever it held, fasting until the enzymes normalise, prophylactic carbapenems and pethidine-only analgesia belong to earlier practice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 药物关联性：药物性胰腺炎是排除性诊断，其证据分级依靠病例报告，最强的一级来自再次用药后复发的报告（Badalov 2007）；塞来昔布相关胰腺炎自 2000 年起有病例报告。关联性用 WHO-UMC 标准或 Naranjo 量表（1981）评价：本例时间关系合理、常见病因已排除、停药后好转，可评为“很可能”（计入已发表的病例报告时，Naranjo 约 5–7 分），但不会是“肯定”，因为不做再激发。当时与现在：报告的标题称为塞来昔布“致”急性胰腺炎；它所记录的证据支持的是“很可能”。
teachingPoints.en: Drug causality: drug-induced pancreatitis is a diagnosis of exclusion whose evidence grades rest on case reports, the strongest being a reported recurrence on re-exposure (Badalov 2007); celecoxib-associated pancreatitis has been reported since 2000. Causality is rated with the WHO-UMC criteria or the Naranjo scale (1981): a plausible time course, the common causes excluded and recovery after withdrawal make this case 'probable' (Naranjo about 5–7 when the published case reports are counted), never 'certain', because no rechallenge is done. Then and now: the report's title calls it celecoxib-induced; the evidence it records supports 'probable'.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 上报与沟通：疑似不良反应要记录、要上报，不必先证实——《药品管理法》（2019）第八十一条要求医疗机构报告疑似不良反应，2011 年《药品不良反应报告和监测管理办法》规定新的或严重的不良反应在 15 日内上报；按国际定义（ICH E2A，1994），导致住院的不良反应属于严重不良反应。要明确、书面地告诉患者避免哪个药，并为她今后的止痛另作安排。当时与现在：1.0.0 版没有记录这次反应是否上报。
teachingPoints.en: Reporting and communication: a suspected reaction is recorded and reported without waiting for proof — China's Drug Administration Law (2019, Article 81) obliges medical institutions to report suspected reactions, and the 2011 Measures set 15 days for new or serious ones; a reaction that leads to admission is serious by the international definition (ICH E2A, 1994). Tell the patient plainly, and in writing, which drug to avoid, and plan her future pain relief. Then and now: 1.0.0 does not record whether this reaction was reported.
